title: ACT ON THE SUPPORT OF THE ACADEMY OF KOREAN STUDIES
full_text:
ACT ON THE SUPPORT OF THE ACADEMY OF KOREAN STUDIES

Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Act is to contribute to the creation and development of national culture by protecting and fostering the Academy of Korean Studies, a non-profit foundation established to promote Korean studies through in-depth research and education on Korean culture.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 17, 2010]

Article 2 (Contributions) (1) The State or a local government may provide contributions to the Academy of Korean Studies (hereinafter referred to as the "Academy") to cover expenses necessary for its basic facilities, equipment, and operations.
  (2) Matters necessary for the provision, use, and management of contributions under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  (3) Any individual, corporation, or organization may contribute money or other property to the Academy to support its projects.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 17, 2010]

Article 3 (Loan of State-owned and public property) (1) The State or a local government may, notwithstanding the State Property Act or the Public Property and Commodity Management Act, lend or transfer to the Academy without consideration State-owned or public property needed for its establishment and fostering, or permit the Academy to use or profit from such property without consideration.
  (2) Matters necessary for the details, conditions, and procedures, etc. for the gratuitous loan, transfer, or use of and profiting from State-owned or public property under paragraph (1) shall be prescribed by Presidential Decree.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 17, 2010]

Article 4 (Secondment of research personnel) (1) Where particularly necessary to achieve its purposes, the Academy may request the State, a local government, an educational institution, or a research organization to second research personnel, etc. to the Academy via the Minister of Education. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
  (2) The head of an institution or organization requested under paragraph (1) may second its members to the Academy in consultation with the Academy.
  (3) A person seconded to the Academy under paragraph (2) shall be deemed to serve in his or her original institution during the period of secondment, and shall not be subject to any disadvantageous treatment in terms of his or her status on the ground of such secondment.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 17, 2010]

Article 5 (Provision of materials) (1) The Academy may request the State, a public organization, an educational institution, or a research organization to distribute publications, such as research papers, survey reports, and reports related to humanities and social sciences, and other materials. In such cases, the institution requested shall comply with the request unless there is a special reason. <Amended on May 29, 2016>
  (2) The Academy may request a person who possesses rare materials necessary for research, such as classics, etc., to allow the reading or copying of such materials. In such cases, the person requested shall comply with the request unless there is a special reason.
  (3) Where a person who has provided materials under paragraphs (1) and (2) so requests, the Academy shall pay just compensation.
  (4) Materials provided to the Academy under paragraphs (1) and (2) shall not be used for any purpose other than research purposes.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 17, 2010]

Article 6 (Establishment of graduate schools) (1) The Academy may establish a graduate school within the Academy with authorization from the Minister of Education to cultivate leading human resources who study the essence of Korean culture. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
  (2) The qualifications for admission, faculty, curricula, and conferment of degrees of the graduate school established under paragraph (1) shall be governed by the Higher Education Act and its subordinate statutes. In such cases, "President" shall be deemed "President of the Academy."
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 17, 2010]

Article 7 (Project plans) The Academy shall prepare a project plan and a budget for each fiscal year and submit them to the Minister of Education. The same shall also apply where it intends to change them. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 17, 2010]

Article 8 (Settlement reports) The Academy shall submit a statement of accounts for revenues and expenditures for each fiscal year, accompanied by the performance of project execution for the relevant year, to the Minister of Education by the end of March of the following year. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 17, 2010]

Article 9 (Prohibition of use of similar names) No person other than the Academy shall use the name "Academy of Korean Studies" or any name similar thereto.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 17, 2010]

Article 10 (Use of facilities of the Academy) (1) The Academy may permit the State, a public organization, an educational institution, or a research organization, etc. to use its facilities, etc. for research, education, training, or practical exercises, to the extent that it does not interfere with its projects.
  (2) Where the facilities, etc. of the Academy are used under paragraph (1), the Academy may be deemed an education and training institution, a research institution, or any other training institution under other statutes, etc.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 17, 2010]

Article 11 (Administrative fines) (1) A person who violates Article 9 shall be subject to an administrative fine not exceeding 5 million won. <Amended on Aug. 20, 2019>
  (2) Administrative fines under paragraph (1) shall be imposed and collected by the Minister of Education, as prescribed by Presidential Decree. <Amended on Mar. 23, 2013>
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Mar. 17, 2010]

Article 12 Deleted. <Jan. 27, 2005>


ADDENDA <Act No. 3116, December 5, 1978>
(1) (Entry into Force) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
(2) (Transitional Measures) Money and goods provided by the State or a local government for the establishment of the Academy at the time this Act enters into force shall be deemed contributions under Article 2(1).

Article 1 (Entry into Force)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>
Articles 2 and 3 omitted.
Article 4 (Amendments to Other Acts Following the Renaming of the Ministry of Education)
Paragraphs (1) through (34) omitted.
(35) The Act on the Support of the Academy of Korean Spiritual Culture is partially amended as follows:
In Article 4(1), Article 6(1), and Articles 7 and 8, “Minister of Education (문교부장관)” is replaced respectively by “Minister of Education (교육부장관).”
Paragraphs (36) through (50) omitted.
Articles 5 through 10 omitted.

ADDENDA (Framework Act on Fund Management) <Act No. 4980, December 6, 1995>
Article 1 (Entry into Force)
This Act shall enter into force on January 1, 1996. <Proviso omitted.>
Article 2 (Amendments to Other Acts)
Paragraphs (1) through (8) omitted.
(9) The Act on the Support of the Academy of Korean Spiritual Culture is partially amended as follows:
In Article 2(1), the words “the formation of the Academy's fund and” are deleted.
Paragraphs (10) through (24) omitted.

ADDENDA (Government Organization Act) <Act No. 6400, January 29, 2001>
Article 1 (Entry into Force)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation. <Proviso omitted.>
Article 2 omitted.
Article 3 (Amendments to Other Acts)
Paragraphs (1) through (42) omitted.
(43) The Act on the Support of the Academy of Korean Spiritual Culture is partially amended as follows:
In Article 4(1), Article 6(1), the first sentence of Article 7, and Article 8, “Minister of Education” is replaced respectively by “Minister of Education and Human Resources Development.”
Paragraphs (44) through (79) omitted.
Article 4 omitted.

ADDENDA <Act No. 7350, January 27, 2005>
(1) (Entry into Force) This Act shall enter into force seven days after the date of its promulgation.
(2) (Transitional Measures concerning Penal Provisions) The previous provisions shall apply when imposing penalties on a person who used the former name “Academy of Korean Spiritual Culture” or any similar name before this Act enters into force.
(3) (Relationship with Other Statutes) Where another statute cites the “Act on the Support of the Academy of Korean Spiritual Culture” or the “Academy of Korean Spiritual Culture” at the time this Act enters into force, it shall be deemed to cite the “Act on the Support of the Academy of Korean Studies” or the “Academy of Korean Studies,” respectively, in its place.

Article 1 (Entry into Force)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation; provided that, ... <omitted> ... amendments under Article 6 of the Addenda to Acts promulgated before this Act enters into force but whose effective dates have not yet arrived shall enter into force on the respective effective dates of those Acts.
Articles 2 through 5 omitted.

Paragraphs (1) through (117) omitted.

Paragraphs (119) through (760) omitted.

(1) (Entry into Force) This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
(2) (Transitional Measures concerning Penal Provisions) The previous provisions shall apply when imposing penalties for acts committed before this Act enters into force.

ADDENDA <Act No. 14168, May 29, 2016>
Article 1 (Entry into Force)
This Act shall enter into force on the date of its promulgation.
Article 2 (Transitional Measures concerning the Provision of Materials by the State and Others)
Where the Academy of Korean Studies requested the State, a public organization, or another such body to distribute materials before this Act enters into force, the previous provisions shall apply notwithstanding the amended latter sentence of Article 5(1).

ADDENDUM <Act No. 16443, August 20, 2019>
This Act shall enter into force six months after the date of its promulgation.
